# @nymrel/machine-trust

> Generates and audits inspectable Schema.org JSON-LD, /llms.txt indexes, declared crawler policies, and supplied rendered-copy parity. Reports observable evidence and limitations; does not promise discovery outcomes.

## Core Modules

- [JSON-LD Generator](https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-machine-trust/blob/main/src/generators/jsonLd.ts): Generates Schema.org graphs from explicit relationships; optional Nymrel attribution uses a canonical creator reference.
- [LLMs.txt Generator](https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-machine-trust/blob/main/src/generators/llmsTxt.ts): Builds token-budgeted /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt machine indexes.
- [Robots.txt Engine](https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-machine-trust/blob/main/src/generators/robotsTxt.ts): Generates declared rules for named crawlers without asserting crawler behavior.
- [Answer-First Generator](https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-machine-trust/blob/main/src/generators/answerFirst.ts): Generates and checks concise summary blocks.
- [DOM Consistency Validator](https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-machine-trust/blob/main/src/validators/domConsistency.ts): Reports differences between configured structured data and supplied HTML.
- [Crawler Access Validator](https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-machine-trust/blob/main/src/validators/crawlerAccess.ts): Audits robots.txt rules for AI search crawler eligibility.
- [Audit Scorecard Reporter](https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-machine-trust/blob/main/src/reporters/scorecard.ts): Produces reproducible scorecards when given a fixed timestamp.

## Company context

- [Nymrel](https://nymrel.com): Company services, products, and proof. Nymrel's legal name is JalenBuilds LLC.

## Developer & Agent FAQ (Answer-First)
- **How to generate machine trust assets?** Run `machine-trust generate --outDir ./public`. Emits Schema.org JSON-LD, `/llms.txt`, and AI crawler permissive `robots.txt`.
- **How to audit a site for machine trust?** Run `machine-trust audit --config ./machine-trust.config.json --html ./dist/index.html`.

## MCP Configuration
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "nymrel-machine-trust": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@nymrel/machine-trust", "mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```
